name: kanban
description: A kanban side pane: Human, Claude, Backlog and Done columns over GitHub Projects or local .kanban/ cards.

backend.title: Card backend
backend.description: Where cards live. auto: GitHub when CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md names a repo and project board and gh is signed in, otherwise local .kanban/ files. github: GitHub only, a failing check is shown instead of falling back. local: always .kanban/ files.

claudeLimit.title: Claude limit
claudeLimit.description: How many cards Claude works on at once. Cards moved to Claude beyond that wait in a queue and start, in order, as cards leave Claude. 0 means no limit.
